notes: Encoded ONLY from FHP's own page. SHIPPED: page Style 5 only (pre-Bosch FHP letter system, year-only; month is a chart-only 2nd-position letter). HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Styles 1a/1b/1c and 2 (Bosch 3-digit year+month code at 5th-7th positions, chart-only; image-pass item) and page Styles 3 and 4 (page states it is currently unable to determine the year; legacy pre-2010 systems). This file is separate from florida-heat-pump; nothing was merged or cross-imported between the two pages, even though they share some serial examples.

styles.era: 9-character serials (2 letters, 6 digits, 1 letter), 1971 through at least 2008, year only
styles.notes: Page: year = 1st position letter; letters I, O, Q not used; cycle repeats with A = 1971 and 1994, B = 1972 & 1995, C = 1973 & 1996, D = 1974 & 1997, E = 1975 & 1998, F = 1976 & 1999, G = 1977 & 2000, etc., extended sequentially skipping I, O, Q. Dual-candidate lists are used only for letters A-R, whose second-cycle years fall within the page's stated era (through at least 2008); letters S-Z carry only their first-cycle year because their second-cycle years (2009-2016) fall after that era and after the page's note that FHP ceased using this style following the 2007 Bosch acquisition — that second-cycle candidate is doubtful, so it is withheld, not shipped. Month = 2nd position letter is chart-only, so year-only; month letters are an image-pass item. Page states FHP was acquired by Bosch in 2007 and has to the best of its knowledge ceased using this style.
